name: Engineers of Shadow-Moon Station
source:
In a world where humanity has begun expanding to the stars, follow the story of a young man who receives a once in a lifetime job offer. He’s recruited as an engineer for a big corporation to work on setting the next stage of space colonization. By taking the job, he would have to move to the newly established Shadow-Moon Station alongside a new partner and together, on top of their engineering duties, they would have to discreetly investigate certain irregularities in the station. This newly formed partnership may soon find themselves in the middle of a corporate power struggle.

[From [url=https://ghost-island-games.itch.io/eosms]Itch.io[/url]]
